coreComponents.BaseEngineAdapter: Universal engine contract defining full lifecycle: detect, inspect, getCapabilities, extractTexts, extractResources, prepareTranslation, translate, restorePlaceholders, validate, applyTranslations, package, launch, rollback, diagnose.
coreComponents.EngineDetector: Structural multi-criteria heuristic scanner inspecting PE headers, DLLs, directory trees, and config signatures.
coreComponents.EngineRegistry: Central registry resolving engineId to adapter instance with fallbacks.
coreComponents.EngineCapabilityMatrix: Formal capability declaration database for all engines and verified versions.
coreComponents.GameService: High-level service orchestrating analysis, dry-run, jobs, pipelines, and transactions.
coreComponents.BackupManager: Transactional backup engine with session/transaction tracking and SHA-256 integrity validation.
coreComponents.CodeProtector: Placeholder and control code masking/restoration for safe translation without breaking syntax.

renpy.exists: Full adapter with RPA extraction, RPY/RPYC parsing, AST scanner, tl/pt_BR generation, and font patching.
renpy.reusable: 100% of pipeline, AST extractor, and tl injection architecture.

rpgmaker_mv_mz.exists: Native JSON patching, plugin injection, hook bridge, cheat overlay, and automated rollback.
rpgmaker_mv_mz.reusable: 100% of JSON parsing and transactional backup.

unity.exists: Detection of Unity Mono vs IL2CPP; basic parsing of AutoTranslator ini/txt dictionaries; BepInEx hook injection if pre-installed; bundled UnityPy 1.25.2 in Tool/resources/unity/site-packages.
unity.incomplete: Native parsing of Unity serialized assets (.assets, resources.assets, AssetBundles, TextAssets, MonoScript/ScriptableObject) was delegated to external tools or OCR instead of utilizing the bundled UnityPy.
unity.diagnosisOnly: IL2CPP games previously classified as OCR-only; Mono games without BepInEx flagged as requiring manual installation.
unity.duplicated: Capability probing logic split between unityAdapter and unityRuntimeCapabilityProbe.
unity.reusable: UnityPy 1.25.2 in Tool/resources/unity/site-packages (confirmed working with Python 3.12), CodeProtector for Unity rich text/tags, AutoTranslator dictionary parser for modded games.

wolf.exists: Detection of Wolf RPG (data.wolf, GuruguruSMF4.dll, BasicData); plain text/JSON scanner in Data folder; reference to UberWolfCli.exe.
wolf.incomplete: Direct extraction and injection of unencrypted/standard Wolf data files (mps, project data, common events) without external UberWolfCli.
wolf.diagnosisOnly: data.wolf games were flagged as REQUIRES_EXTERNAL_TOOL.
wolf.duplicated: Recursive file walk duplicated in extract method.
wolf.reusable: CodeProtector for Wolf RPG escape codes, backup and rollback integration.

rgss.exists: Detection of RGSS1 (XP), RGSS2 (VX), RGSS3 (VX Ace); RpgMakerRubyHandler with Marshal bridge invocation; word-wrap and font patch scripts.
rgss.incomplete: Standalone Marshal bridge script (resources/rpgmaker/marshal_bridge.py) missing or not standalone, causing fallback to fail.
rgss.diagnosisOnly: Games with encrypted rgss3a/rvdata2 flagged as external tool required.
rgss.duplicated: RpgMakerAdapter routes to RpgMakerRubyHandler with duplicated backup logic.
rgss.reusable: Word-wrap script, font patch logic, and ruby text protection.

godot.exists: Detection of Godot 3.x and 4.x (.pck, project.godot); CSV and PO/MO native localization parser and serializer.
godot.incomplete: Binary PCK archive reader/writer for games where localization or scenes are packed inside .pck.
godot.diagnosisOnly: PCK without loose CSV/PO marked as static scene scanner fallback.
godot.reusable: GodotLocalizationProvider CSV/PO parser, Godot token protector.
